messages.subject: Sorry re: Serena's party spam
parts:
I appear to have spammed half of planet earth with an e-vite invitation to my wife's surprise ( not so much anymore...Surprise! ) party. Sorry, we can't accommodate that many. However, if you know us, feel free to stop by. Otherwise, my apologies for a strange email.

John
